stem:
Charu’s neighbour develops a swollen neck that the doctor calls goitre from iodine shortage. The doctor also says vitamins and minerals are protective nutrients, Vitamin C shortage can cause scurvy with bleeding gums, and iodised salt supplies iodine. Charu’s family uses plain non-iodised salt.

Answer both parts.

parts.text: Which claim about protective nutrients fits this case?

options.text: Vitamins and minerals help protect the body; iodised salt can address iodine deficiency.
Non-iodised common salt can correct iodine deficiency.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: Vitamins and minerals are protective; iodine from iodised salt prevents goitre, while non-iodised salt does not supply iodine.

teacher.key_rationale: Protective vitamins and minerals prevent disease; iodised salt corrects iodine shortage. Iodine does not cause scurvy; non-iodised salt cannot fix iodine deficiency; scurvy does not cause the Vitamin C shortage.
